fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Vehicle Parking Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence without obstruction.
• Mark or label the detached structure with a visible identifier so responders can distinguish it from the main residence during an emergency.
• Keep rear access points unlocked and unobstructed so responders can reach the back of the property without delay.
• Post the property address at the point where the access drive meets the road if the main residence is not visible from the street.

wildfire.conditions: Open Terrain; Scattered Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Brush Area; Mixed Vegetation; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Trees; Open Green Space; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin scattered trees near structures to increase open space between tree canopies and rooflines.
• Remove shrubs growing directly adjacent to any exterior walls or under deck areas.
• Cut back brush at the edges of the property where it borders open terrain to reduce continuous plant material leading toward structures.
• Keep open green space areas mowed short and free of dead plant buildup.
• Trim low-hanging branches on scattered trees closest to the house to raise the canopy height off the ground.
• Remove any dead or dry plant material within mixed vegetation areas near structures before dry season.
• Maintain clear ground between shrub groupings and structures so fire cannot travel directly to the building.
